title: Free abelian quotients of commensurators
summary: For every group $Γ$, we define a homomorphism $d^Γ: \mathrm{Comm}(Γ) \to \mathbb{Z}^{(\mathcal{FS})}$ from the abstract commensurator $\mathrm{Comm}(Γ)$ to the free abelian group $\mathbb{Z}^{(\mathcal{FS})}$ with basis the collection $\mathcal{FS}$ of isomorphism classes of finite simple groups. We investigate the homomorphism $d^Γ$ when $Γ$ is a finitely generated free group $F$. We explicitly describe the image of $d^F : \mathrm{Comm}(F) \to \mathbb{Z}^{(\mathcal{FS})}$, which is a free abelian group of infinite rank, and we show that the kernel is the monolith of the group…
